hook: Did investigators really carry out serious actions without approval during Benjamin Netanyahu's corruption probes?

sections.voiceover: Did investigators really carry out serious actions without approval during Benjamin Netanyahu's corruption probes?

Former Attorney General Avichai Mandelblit testified at the Jerusalem District Court about the investigation. Amit Hadad clashed with prosecutor Yehudit Tirosh during the hearing. What did Mandelblit admit about police actions?
Except the former attorney general expressed surprise that anything was hidden.

Mandelblit revealed investigators carried out serious actions without approval during Benjamin Netanyahu's corruption probes. High-pitched tones erupted between lawyers inside the courtroom. Yehudit Tirosh faced Amit Hadad during the Jerusalem District Court hearings.
